title: Fantastic
content:
So pleased my brother in law showed me this app.  Polarsteps has made it so easy to record our holiday on the go.  
I’ve always wondered if there was an easy quick way to record & share our memories as they happen & now I’ve found it.
 We’ve had some wonderful travel adventures in the past & now I hope to make photo books of them with Polarsteps.  Hassle free 
So thank you Polarsteps much appreciated.
Cheers Vonne
author: Vonne & Geoff

title: Good app, could be Great!
content:
I’ve been travelling for over 1250 days and so there’s a ton of data on my app which slows it down significantly, which is understandable. 
What I would like to see however is to be able to remove/re-do the straight lines on my map which happens when you haven’t opened the app in a while or the phone for some reason can’t track where you are. The accurate lines on the map where you’ve been is probably the best feature, let me redraw the lines if they’re wrong/straight. 
One more thing, sometimes when I publish a “step” and I want to upload some videos and the app tells me something went wrong with one of the videos. I now have no idea what video the app can’t upload and have to manually delete each video to see which one it was. Is there no way to see in your draft which video I can’t upload?

Other than this it’s a great app to keep friends and family up to date on where you are and what you’re doing!
author: Guus van Gisteren

title: Never again
content:
Used this app twice now for long trips, won’t happen again. I would stop using it  now if I wasn’t mid-trip. 
• drains my battery even when I have tracking off when app is off
• makes my phone super hot, effecting the brightness of my screen and making other apps get glitchy from heat - again, even when app is off
• search function for places and locations is horrible and I have to find a lot of the places manually through comparing location with separate map app or just skip the recommended location altogether
• notes are posted for entire step, cannot be added as captions to specific pictures • when loading a lot of pictures and want to get specific about some it’s not possible 
• slow to respond in general 
• last time I used it was a year ago and it has gotten markedly worst
• apps like Wanderlog are far superior, more comprehensive and don’t appear to have the same problems (partner using that while on same trip so can compare)
author: Anonymous 30-30

title: Great app
content: Polarsteps has been a brilliant way to write up our daily activities along with the best photos each day on our 34 day trip over many countries.  It’s a great way to capture your trip and share it with family and friends and get a book at the end to remember it all by.  We would have lost track of what and when we did things if we hadn’t had this app.
author: Luckey1234

title: Awesome travel diary app
content:
Have been travelling for the last 18 months and Polarsteps has tracked the whole thing in the background of my phone without even being open 👍 
Allows me to add notes and photos easily, post my progress along a map for my family to track back home, and to share with social media easily. 
There are some usability issues, but they are minor and I would still definitely recommend!
author: Carinabean88

title: Fantastic shared diary
content: Have used Polarsteps for all my trips over the past couple of years. My family and friends love it as much as I do as they can share my trip through my photos, the maps and my story. Even better, they can make comments and ask questions. The map helps me to go back and find photos or details I want to recall months or years later.
author: Mayd in NZ

title: Fantastic record
content: I travelled by myself for 6 months in 2019 but never felt alone with Polar Steps - my friends were with me all the way. It also gives you a fantastic record of your trip. The book could be easier to produce - mine is the biggest you can do, but it’s top quality and keeps on jogging my memory of the wonderful experiences I enjoyed on my epic adventure.
author: AEVKP

title: Polar steps awesome!
content: My daughter is travelling in Asia. I’m Dad in New Zealand. Polar steps shows where she is, inserts her photos & allows her to keep a running commentary/diary of where she is & what she’s up to. It’s awesome - she can keep us in contact whilst just jotting down her daily diary - and we know where she is without having to do anything to tell us - feels safer from the other side of the world. Great stuff Polar Steps!!
author: Skiwikiwi

title: Middle East/Europe/Asia holiday
content:
This app was recommended to me by a German couple. Best app I have come across in a very long time. I now have a ‘living’ history of my travels by way of photos and how I felt about each day. This is in effect a diary. 
Not only can I review it for my own interests at any time, but I can share it with friends and family. 
Brilliant, and all thanks to
my German friends.
author: plabapp

title: Reads Ritz BnB - NZ
content: I really love this idea of simply adding your travels to this App in a simple way.  Especially for travellers who are time poor.  And for me as I am not savvy with internet cleverness!! All through Polar Steps.

title: Intuitive and professional

title: Better than brilliant!
content: Many reviewers say Polarsteps is brilliant, but that is an understatement. It is so easy to use, quick to update and great to follow. I have used it in South America in he Amazon’s don in Namibia in the desert - the offline sync is great, it keeps gps tracks of you very well and the photo integration excellent. The maps are gorgeous too! Get it, you won’t regret it!
